results.title: Researcher studying Acadian wills says they were 'an act of resistance'
results.description: Colby Gaudet, a post-doctoral fellow at Dalhousie University, is studying how some families navigated the legal and religious practices associated with grief and death. What he found is a community adapting to a society that saw them as outsiders, while also asserting their religion and culture.

results.title: Princess Iman welcomes twin daughters Talia and Rania with husband Jameel Alexander Thermiotis, names newborns after Queen Rania; Jordanian royal family celebrates
results.description: Princess Iman of Jordan and her husband Jameel Alexander Thermiotis have welcomed twin daughters, Talia and Rania. The newborns were born on August 14, bringing a double celebration to King Abdullah II and Queen Rania, who are now grandparents to four granddaughters. The couple’s older daughter, Amina, has also become a big sister.
